comment: 11yo female with biallelic RECQL4 germline truncating variants confirmed (Type-II Rothmund-Thomson), classic poikiloderma (atrophy + telangiectasias + pigmentary changes on cheeks since infancy, now extending to extremities) + sparse hair/eyebrows + bilateral radial ray hypoplasia + short stature. No current osteosarcoma or non-melanoma skin cancer. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = pediatric orthopedic-oncology osteosarcoma surveillance (limb MRI q6-12mo from age 5, low-threshold imaging on any musculoskeletal symptom) + dermatology q6mo NMSC surveillance + sun-protection counseling + diagnostic-imaging-radiation minimization (favor MR over CT); alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-B rare-hereditary pilot — fires RF-ROTHMUND-THOMSON-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION.
